title: Panel Templates & Page Layout Grammar
objective: Define deterministic page/panel layout grammar over sealed SAA-01 project/page/panel identities, including common panel grids, gutters, margins, bleed/safe-area rules and freeform panel layouts, without implementing the SAA-03 interactive composition canvas.
acceptance: Common panel-grid templates are typed, versioned and deterministic.
Margins, gutters, bleed and safe-area values are explicit schema state with validated bounds.
Freeform panel geometry is representable without mutating SAA-01 project/page/panel identity.
Template application yields deterministic panel-layout state and stable serialization.
Reading order is explicit and independent from incidental rendering coordinates.
Layout grammar remains presentation/authoring state and does not mutate Scene, Character, ARI or other canonical owner truth.
Keyboard/textual equivalents can represent blocking layout operations for later UI consumption.
Provider-off local operation is supported; optional AI and paid cloud are not required.
SAA-03 interactive composition behavior and later SAA tranches remain unauthorized.
boundaries: SAA-01.1 remains sealed and owns project/page/panel/layer schema identity.
SAA-02 defines layout grammar only; drag/resize/crop/z-order interaction belongs to SAA-03.
ARI and source-domain owners remain authoritative.
No export/share/publication or final Creator integration authority is granted.
next_action: Await a later explicit owner Continue before governed-starting SAA-02.
